title: Icariin ameliorates LPS-induced acute lung injury in mice via complement C5a-C5aR1 and TLR4 signaling pathways.
authors: Guo, Jing; Zhang, Qi-Yun; Xu, Lin; Li, Min; Sun, Qian-Yun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究淫羊藿苷通过补体C5a-C5aR1和TLR4信号通路改善小鼠急性肺损伤，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute lung injury (ALI) is an acute respiratory-related progressive disorder, which lacks specific pharmacotherapy. Icariin (ICA) has been shown to be effective in treating ALI. However, the targets and pharmacological mechanisms underlying the effects of ICA in the treatment of ALI are relatively lacking. Based on network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses, the gene functions and potential target pathways of ICA in the treatment of ALI were determined. In addition, the underlying mechanisms of ICA were verified by immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, quantitative Real-time PCR, and Western blot in LPS-induced ALI mice. The biological processes targeted by ICA in the treatment of ALI included the pathological changes, inflammatory response, and cell signal transduction. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo experimental results revealed that ICA inhibited the complement C5a-C5aR1 axis, TLR4 mediated NF-kappaB, MAPK, and JAK2-STAT3 signaling pathways related gene and protein expressions, and decreased inflammatory cytokine, chemokine, adhesion molecule expressions, and mitochondrial apoptosis in LPS-induced ALI.
abstract_zh: 急性肺损伤（ALI）是一种与急性呼吸相关的进行性疾病，目前缺乏特异性药物治疗。淫羊藿苷（ICA）已被证明对治疗ALI有效。然而，ICA在治疗ALI中发挥作用所涉及的靶点及药理机制相对缺乏研究。基于网络药理学和分子对接分析，确定了ICA治疗ALI的基因功能和潜在靶点通路。此外，通过免疫组织化学、免疫荧光、实时定量PCR和Western blot在LPS诱导的ALI小鼠中验证了ICA的潜在机制。ICA治疗ALI所靶向的生物学过程包括病理变化、炎症反应和细胞信号转导。网络药理学、分子对接及体内实验结果表明，ICA抑制了补体C5a-C5aR1轴、TLR4介导的NF-kappaB、MAPK和JAK2-STAT3信号通路相关基因和蛋白的表达，并降低了LPS诱导的ALI中炎症细胞因子、趋化因子、黏附分子的表达及线粒体凋亡。
